categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the semiconductor thermoelectric industry, focusing on the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor thermoelectric devices, thermoelectric systems, and thermoelectric integrated machines. Their product portfolio includes semiconductor thermoelectric cooling devices, thermoelectric power generation devices, thermoelectric cooling systems, and finished thermoelectric products such as temperature-controlled wine cabinets, electronic refrigerators, beer machines, and smart mattresses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor thermoelectric technologies based on the Peltier effect, including proprietary materials preparation techniques like zone melting, powder hot pressing, and hot extrusion of bismuth telluride materials. They have developed automated assembly technologies for thermoelectric devices, micro-device assembly, low-cold-loss sealing, and reliability screening technologies. Their system integration technologies optimize heat exchanger design and thermal resistance reduction, while their finished products incorporate patented technologies for insulation, humidity control, and precise temperature regulation. The company also employs digital and automated manufacturing systems such as SAP ERP, MES, and WMS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span multiple industries including consumer electronics (notably brands like SEB, Electrolux, Midea, Jura), telecommunications (leading optical module manufacturers), energy storage (companies like CATL, EVE Energy), and automotive sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, providing ODM and branded products domestically and ODM products internationally. Major end markets include consumer electronics, communication equipment, energy storage systems, automotive temperature control, and medical devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It serves both domestic and international markets, with significant export sales. The international customer base includes companies in Europe, America, and other regions, supported by compliance with global certifications and standards.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Fuxin Technology operates across the full semiconductor thermoelectric industry chain, covering upstream materials preparation, midstream device and system manufacturing, and downstream integrated thermoelectric product applications. They produce core components in-house, including thermoelectric materials, devices, and systems, and also manufacture finished thermoelectric products, positioning themselves as a vertically integrated supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in thermoelectric materials, device fabrication, system integration, and finished product development. It invests heavily in R&D (6.55% of revenue in 2024) and collaborates with top research institutes. Key R&D projects focus on high-performance thermoelectric devices for automotive, communication (400G/800G optical modules), energy storage dehumidification, and consumer electronics. The company aims to enhance product efficiency, reliability, and miniaturization, while expanding intelligent manufacturing and digital factory capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor thermoelectric devices, systems, and finished thermoelectric products. The company employs both ODM and branded sales models, with ODM predominant in international markets and a mix of ODM and own-brand sales domestically. Additional income streams include government subsidies and investment income from financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Guangdong Fuxin Technology is a leading domestic player in the semiconductor thermoelectric industry, recognized as a high-tech enterprise with comprehensive capabilities across the entire industry chain. It holds a strong market position in consumer electronics and is expanding rapidly in communication, energy storage, and automotive sectors. The company benefits from advanced proprietary technologies, scale advantages, and a broad customer base, positioning it ahead of many competitors in China’s emerging thermoelectric market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 515.6 million, a 29.04% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 44.48 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.004 billion, up 10.25% from the previous year. The company’s net asset value was RMB 698.56 million, growing 2.54%. Cash flow from operations nearly doubled, reflecting strong sales growth and improved collections. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with increasing R&D investment and expanding production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive semiconductor thermoelectric technology solutions, combining advanced materials, device manufacturing, system integration, and finished product applications. Its products offer high reliability, precise temperature control, energy efficiency, environmental friendliness (solid-state cooling without refrigerants), and noise-free operation. The vertically integrated production and proprietary technologies enable cost advantages, quality control, and rapid customization to meet diverse customer needs across multiple industries. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and strategic partnerships further differentiate it in the market.
